examined_formations.title: EMAIL_DELIVERABILITY_SEED_NETWORK
examined_formations.chinese_title: 邮件送达率种子网络与声誉修复
examined_formations.payer_evidence: InboxAlly currently publishes recurring plans from $149 to $1,190 per month, with higher enterprise tiers.
examined_formations.execution_created_asset: Each warmup/placement run generates engagement and placement observations, while the provider operates a reusable seed-mail network.
examined_formations.ownership_and_reuse: The decisive sender reputation accrues primarily to the customer's domain/sender, while the reusable seed network is already the provider's established infrastructure.

examined_formations.title: AI_VOICE_AGENT_CALL_OUTCOME_LOOP
examined_formations.chinese_title: AI语音代理通话结果学习循环
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Current platforms publish usage pricing and paid production tiers; Vapi charges usage plus packages and Bland charges per-minute with paid team tiers.
examined_formations.execution_created_asset: Every call can generate transcripts, dispositions, tool traces, conversion outcomes and failure patterns.
examined_formations.ownership_and_reuse: Customer call data is operationally sensitive and often customer-owned; Vapi explicitly positions customers as owning and operating their agents/models/data. Cross-customer reuse is therefore not a default operator right.

examined_formations.title: CROSS_MERCHANT_FRAUD_NETWORK
examined_formations.chinese_title: 跨商户反欺诈网络效应
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Dedicated fraud platforms are established enterprise budget lines, using SaaS, usage, GMV or guarantee-linked pricing models.
examined_formations.execution_created_asset: Every evaluated transaction can strengthen identity, device, behavioral and fraud-pattern knowledge across merchants.
examined_formations.ownership_and_reuse: This is a true cross-customer compounding asset when contracts permit it.

examined_formations.title: INTELLIGENT_DOCUMENT_PROCESSING_FEEDBACK_LOOP
examined_formations.chinese_title: 智能文档处理纠错学习循环
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Rossum publishes a Starter plan beginning at $18,000/year; Nanonets prices workflow blocks by execution.
examined_formations.execution_created_asset: Human validation/correction improves extraction and workflow accuracy over time.
examined_formations.ownership_and_reuse: Rossum describes feedback as training a business's dedicated model; invoice/document data is highly customer-specific and confidential, limiting a clean cross-customer reusable operator asset.

examined_formations.title: REAL_DEVICE_AND_BROWSER_TESTING_CLOUD
examined_formations.chinese_title: 真实设备与浏览器测试云
examined_formations.payer_evidence: BrowserStack and Sauce Labs publish paid testing plans from tens to hundreds of dollars per month and enterprise tiers.
examined_formations.execution_created_asset: Repeated tests can create failure signatures, compatibility observations and tooling improvements.
examined_formations.ownership_and_reuse: The durable operator asset is the expensive device/browser fleet plus mature testing infrastructure; customer test results are mostly application-specific.

examined_formations.title: LLM_OBSERVABILITY_AND_EVALUATION_TRACE_LOOP
examined_formations.chinese_title: LLM可观测与评测Trace学习循环
examined_formations.payer_evidence: Langfuse, Arize AX and Braintrust publish current paid plans and usage-based pricing.
examined_formations.execution_created_asset: Production traces, scores and failures can become evaluation datasets and regression tests; Braintrust explicitly describes turning failing traces into eval datasets.
examined_formations.ownership_and_reuse: The most valuable traces and labeled outcomes belong to each customer's application context; cross-customer reuse is constrained, while the observability/eval tooling category is already crowded.
